description: This file defines an Angular component 'SingleTimelineComponent' responsible for rendering and managing a timeline visualization, handling user interactions such as hover and click, and updating the display accordingly.

classes.name: SingleTimelineComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying an interactive timeline, supporting hover effects, selection, and responsive resizing.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, throws error if required inputs are missing.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up resize observer and initializes canvas size and drawing context.

methods.name: initializeCanvas
methods.description: Configures the canvas size and scale for high DPI displays, and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input changes and triggers redraw if the view is initialized.

methods.name: handleMouseOut
methods.description: Handles mouse leaving the canvas, resets hover state.

methods.name: getXScale
methods.description: Returns current X scale factor from the canvas' transform.

methods.name: getYScale
methods.description: Returns current Y scale factor from the canvas' transform.

methods.name: private handleMouseMove
methods.description: Handles mouse move events, updates hover entry and cursor.

methods.name: private drawEntryHover
methods.description: Draws hover effect over the timeline entry at the mouse position.

methods.name: private clearCanvas
methods.description: Clears the canvas for redrawing.

methods.name: private getEntryAt
methods.description: Returns the trace entry at given mouse coordinates, or undefined if none.

methods.name: private updateCursor
methods.description: Updates cursor style based on whether an entry is under the mouse.

methods.name: private handleMouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse click, selects the closest trace entry and emits position update.

methods.name: getScaledCanvasWidth
methods.description: Returns scaled width of the canvas.

methods.name: getScaledCanvasHeight
methods.description: Returns scaled height of the canvas.

methods.name: get entryWidth
methods.description: Returns width of each timeline entry.

methods.name: get availableWidth
methods.description: Returns the available width for timeline entries excluding entry width.

methods.name: private defineEntryPath
methods.description: Defines the drawing path for a timeline entry based on its timestamp.

methods.name: private redraw
methods.description: Clears and redraws the timeline.

methods.name: private drawTimeline
methods.description: Iterates over trace entries and draws each, also draws selected entry.

methods.name: private drawEntry
methods.description: Draws a single timeline entry.

methods.name: private drawSelectedEntry
methods.description: Highlights the selected trace entry.
